newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start firm but traders remain wary.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start firm but traders remain wary.

text.p: European meals and feeds were offered into the cash market here at firmer levels on Friday but the prospect of weather-related gyrations on the Chicago market was enough to keep players sidelined.
The firm close on Chicago on Thursday, on reports of more dry weather in the Midwest, left sellers here offering South American soymeal around five or six dollars up.
But the potential for weather forecasts to change over the weekend, and jolt the market at the Monday opening would mean only the most necessary of business would be done today.
But there were no trades reported in early dealings.
